name: Master Kira Voss

greeting.stranger: I sense you are drawn to the Force. Welcome, seeker.
greeting.acquaintance: You return to the path. Good. The Force guides you.
greeting.friend: My friend, your connection to the Force grows stronger. I am proud.
greeting.confidant: You have become a true seeker. The ancient teachings await you.

questRelated.js_dantooine_01_enclave_call: The Jedi Enclave on Dantooine... it is one of the most sacred places in Jedi history. Thousands of years ago, Jedi Masters taught here, and the Force was strong. Now it lies in ruins, but the Force remains. I have been called here, and I sense you have been called as well. Will you join me on a pilgrimage to the Enclave? There is much to learn, and perhaps... something to recover.
questRelated.js_dantooine_02_kinrath_crystals: The ancient map fragment you found points to the Kinrath Cave, where Force-sensitive Dantari crystals can be found. These crystals are essential for lightsaber construction and Force enhancements. But the cave is extremely dangerous—kinrath creatures guard it fiercely. I believe you're ready for this challenge, but I must warn you: the cave will test both your combat skills and your connection to the Force. The Kinrath Matriarch is a formidable opponent. Are you prepared?
questRelated.js_dantooine_02_kinrath_crystals_locatio: The Kinrath Cave is in the wilderness of Dantooine. You'll need to reach the deepest chamber—depth zone 3—where the crystals grow. The path is treacherous, and the Matriarch guards the crystal chamber. Be careful, and may the Force be with you.

general: The Force flows through all things. Here on Dantooine, it flows especially strong.
The Enclave was abandoned long ago, but the Force remembers.
To be a Jedi Seeker is not about power. It is about understanding.
The ancient Jedi had wisdom we have lost. We must recover it.
The dark side tempts those who seek power. The light side rewards those who seek understanding.

appearance.distinguishingFeatures: Jedi robes (simple, not traditional), lightsaber hilt at belt, serene expression, Force-sensitive aura

biography: Master Kira Voss is a Jedi Seeker who has dedicated her life to recovering lost Jedi knowledge and teaching others about the Force. She's not part of a formal Jedi Order—those days are gone—but she represents the continuation of Jedi ideals. She's wise, patient, and deeply connected to the Force. She's come to Dantooine because she feels the Force calling her to the ancient Enclave, and she believes the player is meant to join her on this pilgrimage.
